ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions centrally; dense black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge (~15-20% of lobe width); scattered black focal spots concentrated in the mid-left lobe; radial black stippling and streaks on the right lobe extending from the base towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; vertex is partially obscured by water spray but suggests an angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; sharp, irregular peaks (approx. 10-15 pixel amplitude) spaced at intervals of 20-40 pixels along the visible length of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a gentle convex curve along the interior transitioning to a tapered, slightly concave profile towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of approx. 5 distinct dark circular clusters in the left-central lobe; dense white high-contrast clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the white surfaces of both lobes, most prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme distal tips show irregular, ragged topography with significant bulbous white encrustations (barnacles); right tip has a more pronounced protrusion.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the lower central region and peduncle junction by high-intensity white water spray and foam.
